title.en: An Act Appropriating the Sum of thirty-Five thousand Pesos for Agricultural and Industrial Advancement, Sanitation and Irrigation in the Mountain Province, and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
The sum of thirty-five thousand pesos is hereby appropriated for the Mountain Province out of
any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to be expended under the direction of the
Secretary of the Interior for agricultural and industrial advancement, sanitation, education, and irrigation,
including salaries and wages, traveling expenses, and purchase of supplies and material and other incidental
expenses: Provided, That expenditures from this fund are hereby authorized for the construction of irrigation
ditches for townships and groups of individuals.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, August 26, 1915.
